name: Work visas

activity.text_en: What will you do in Indonesia?

sponsor.text_en: Do you have a sponsor in Indonesia who will provide your work?

initial_stay.text_en: Which initial stay do you need?

notes: Only E23 has substantive official content. E23A/U/V/X/Y are NOT_FOUND secondary cards: TO_VERIFY, permit_class NULL, all unstated legal and commercial fields NULL, excluded from the Guide.

Three questions: work activity, sponsor providing work, exact initial stay. Documents, including the Ministry of Manpower work permission, remain the verbatim checklist; no document-possession question is added.

Initial stays are exactly 180 DAY, 1 YEAR or 2 YEAR. The optional stay_question selects one stated option without calendar conversion. 180 days is never treated as six months. Numeric stay_days/stay_months answers cannot replace an initial_stay choice.

Extension is explicitly allowed through the sponsor, but no cumulative maximum, extension increment or renewal count is stated. Both maxima remain NULL; this Guide assesses the selected initial permit only and offers no unverified extension-duration calculation.

The five exact kitas_permits keys cover Working KITAS and Freelance E23. These are commercial references for E23, not legal permission for unsponsored freelance work or a price quote for every stay tier. Working initial products say 1 year; Freelance products say 6 months, which is not equated to the Law card's 180 days. No 2-year price is invented.
E23-FREELANCE is legacy-only, without an official code card; no new code or separate Guide route is created.

ITAP.json states no per-code ITAP eligibility. Each card retains its exact visa_page_itap_verbatim, with itap_eligibility_as_stated_boolean NULL and itap_status TO_VERIFY. The general worker-category text does not establish an E23-code mapping. DB itap remains NULL; no ITAP question or KITAP price is offered.

Application location remains NULL for every code. Offshore/onshore commercial key labels do not establish a legal application-channel rule. VERIFIED means faithful source extraction, not full legal eligibility.
